5a.line: Flow stops in rundown line (pump trip, start-up, shutdown) — stagnant butadiene polymerizes even with residual TBC, plugs 400 m insulated line; restart attempts overpressure and rupture line

5b.line: Polymerization or solid buildup of butadiene due to stagnation in a normally closed line. — Accumulated solids could obstruct flow when the line is opened, causing overpressure upstream, potential release of butadiene, fire, explosion, or damage to downstream equipment.

5a.line: Steam purge (step 5) leaves flammable vapour in reactor and main fractionator — air ingress during maintenance entry (step 8) creates explosive atmosphere, ignited by pyrophoric catalyst or hot surfaces

5a-plant.line: Combustion air control failure drives excess air to REGENERATOR; oxygen breaks through in flue gas to EXPANDER and CO-BOILER, creating explosive mixture with residual CO. — Explosion in EXPANDER or CO-BOILER, hot flue gas discharge to stack area, structural damage to flue gas path, potential escalation to regenerator.

5b-from-hybrid.line: Procedure step skipped or done out of order (operator error) — Naphtha vapour mixed with air creates a flammable mixture; an ignition source could lead to fire or explosion in the gas plant.

5a.line: Hot work (welding/grinding) on T-32 roof ignites flammable vapors venting from foul condensate tanks — flash fire/explosion in tank headspaces and vent header, roof collapse, personnel fatalities

5a-plant.line: Hot work (cutting, welding, grinding) on the roof of T-32 ignites flammable vapours (methanol, turpentine, organics) that escape from the tank vent or overflow while the tank remains in service with a floating organic layer. — Tank fire or explosion, personnel injury or fatality, release of burning organics to atmosphere via vent header, potential escalation to adjacent tanks T-31 and T-33 through common vent/overflow headers.

5b-from-hybrid.line: Hot work ignition source near black liquor leak — Ignition of black liquor vapors leading to fire, release of heat, smoke, SO2.

hybrid-codeorder.line: Mechanical seal replacement on the stripper feed pump (W-2) results in seal failure (immediate or delayed), releasing methanol/turpentine/organics mixture from T-33 under pump suction pressure. — Flammable and toxic liquid spray in pump area; pool fire if ignited; personnel exposure to methanol (toxic) and turpentine; potential vapour migration to nearby hot work on T-32 roof.

5a.line: Wrong tote selected and charged due to hand-labelled totes and manual paper batch sheet — incorrect stoichiometry triggers runaway hydrosilylation or hydrogen evolution, overpressurising mixing tank
